description: Replay your agent journal oldest→newest (CO 230-001). Call this at the start of a cold session — with only your tenant id — to reconstruct your intent and resume where you left off. Pairs with federation_journal_append. Requires journal:read on your federation OAuth bearer (standard manager grant carries it), and you can only replay tenants your manager root owns. Returns: The journal entries oldest→newest (up to limit). Example: call federation_journal_read with arguments {"tenant_id":"<tenant_id>"}.

tenant_id.description: Your tenant id whose journal to replay.

name: federation_journal_read
